name: kana-review
description: Adversarial second-harness review, run inline - for code, PRs, plans, docs, math, and creative content. Untrusts every claim including its own training, web-verifies external facts, runs tests and validators to ground findings (read-only = no authorship, not no execution), and reports them with severity and confidence through a re-review loop to explicit approval. Invoke from a fresh review session.
